verdictEs: Maxroll si quieres guías editoriales profundas con leveling step-by-step y endgame setups por skill, escritas por jugadores top y revisadas con cada parche. Mobalytics si valoras un build hub PoE 2-focused con planner web propio integrado y tracker de progreso.
verdictEn: Maxroll if you want deep editorial guides with step-by-step leveling and per-skill endgame setups, written by top players and revised each patch. Mobalytics if you value a PoE 2-focused build hub with its own integrated web planner and progress tracker.
